_comment: **Every visual colour is stated, and stated as the nether's**, which is the world this type restates. An attribute a dimension type says nothing about falls back to its *registered* default, and for these three that default is #000000 — so an unstated colour is not a question handed to the biome, it is black. A biome overrides where it declares one and most do not: plains and beach carry no fog colour. `fog_color` and `sky_color` were left out on the reasoning that biomes carry their own, and every Age came up with black fog at every height over every landform (Jonah, 2026-09-03); `ambient_light_color` had already been caught the same way once. `ambient_light` is a separate system and is not the one you can see: it reaches only `LevelReader.getBrightness`, where the lightmap is built from `ambient_light_color`, `sky_light_color` and `sky_light_factor`.
